sourceText: Fix `lattice codex verify` in the global-thin project `/Users/jek/Documents/Work/deepswe-pos-codex-gpt55-run/solver-visible`, where only `Global fallback heartbeat` fails with `no activity heartbeat for session codex-check-global-...`. The root cause is Proofbound CLI activity logging using canonical `lattice.config.json` detection while global-thin managed projects only have `.lattice/lattice.json`. Add a narrow runtime/activity root helper that accepts canonical `lattice.config.json` and `.lattice/lattice.json` with `assetMode: global-thin`, without making `loadConfig()` parse `.lattice/lattice.json`; add regression/smoke coverage; build and rerun the solver-visible verify.
normalizedOutcome: Running `lattice codex verify` in `/Users/jek/Documents/Work/deepswe-pos-codex-gpt55-run/solver-visible` no longer fails Global fallback heartbeat with `no activity heartbeat for session ...`; the heartbeat records to `.lattice/activity.jsonl` with `source=codex` and `entrypoint=global-fallback`.
acceptanceClaim: The fixed Proofbound CLI preserves canonical config loading while activity logging recognizes managed global-thin roots, and the real solver-visible `lattice codex verify` smoke exits successfully without the prior Global fallback heartbeat hard failure.
